Actually testCloneSuperCloneThrowsCloneNotSupportedException defines its own inner class NonCloneableMessage, which shadows outer. The outer class also defined earlier but not used; we can keep but fix compile. It also has same error with RuntimeException. We'll fix.

Also need to import java.lang.reflect.Method; Already covered.

Also need to import java.util.List, LinkedList, Collections.

Also need to import org.xbill.DNS.Section (enum). Actually Section is a class with static ints? In DNS library, Section is a class with constants: QUESTION, ANSWER, AUTHORITY, ADDITIONAL. It's probably org.xbill.DNS.Section. So import that.

Also import org.xbill.DNS.TSIGRecord.

Also import org.xbill.DNS.ARecord, TXTRecord, etc.

Also import org.xbill.DNS.Header.

Also import org.xbill.DNS.Resolver? Not needed.

Also import java.io.IOException.

Now the test class should compile.

Potential other errors: In testCloneResponseDeepCopySections method signature: throws UnknownHostException; need to import java.net.UnknownHostException.

Also need to import java.util.List.

Also need to import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

Now the class is annotated with @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) which requires JUnit Jupiter. Ensure import.

Potential issue: The class is not public; JUnit can run package-private. fine.

Now fix the code.

Also note that the test uses getPrivateField and setPrivateField static methods defined inside class; they throw Exception; fine.

Now produce corrected code.
